title: Chai at Blue Hour
description: An original stylized courier robot pauses for chai in a lantern-lit Indian market. Six seconds of scene and animation proof of concept; not a production human character or a finished movie.

shots.name: market_arrival
shots.action: Courier rolls into the chai market, looking toward the stall.
shots.camera: Wide establishing shot moving smoothly inward.

shots.name: greeting
shots.action: Courier raises its right hand and waves; head and antenna react with overlapping motion.
shots.camera: Continuous three-quarter dolly toward the character.

shots.name: settle
shots.action: Hand settles and the courier turns toward the viewer.
